verdict.rationale: Flagright's case and alert model includes ESCALATED and IN_REVIEW statuses. Its marketing mentions explainable AI agents and a Workflow Builder for investigation flows tailored to compliance logic. Together these suggest findings can be routed to human reviewers, but nothing documents policy-based limits on what the AI agents may automatically remediate. The escalation statuses are the only direct support, so the verdict is a weak partial. Missing for 10: documented policy controls bounding automatic AI remediation, rules that automatically escalate ambiguous or high-risk findings to a human, configuration docs for AI-agent autonomy thresholds, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a ai-native, I can limit automatic remediation by policy and escalate ambiguous or high-risk findings to a human
